categories.main_business_segments: The Group operates primarily in four segments: sewage and reclaimed water treatment and construction services, water distribution services, technical and consultancy services and sale of machineries, and urban resources services including hazardous waste treatment and recycling. These segments cover construction, operation, and maintenance of water treatment plants, water distribution, technical support, and urban environmental governance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group utilizes Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), Transfer-Operate-Transfer (TOT), and Build-Own-Operate (BOO) service concession models for infrastructure projects. It applies proprietary technologies such as prefabricated water plants and MBBR sewage treatment integrated equipment, emphasizing innovation-driven development and digital transformation including cloud platforms and engineering management robots to enhance operational efficiency and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Group serves governmental authorities and public utilities primarily in the water treatment and distribution sectors. Its customers include municipal governments and public service entities across Chinese Mainland and overseas markets such as Singapore, Portugal, Australia, New Zealand, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, Botswana, and Kazakhstan. The urban resources segment serves urban environmental governance and hazardous waste treatment clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span across 20 provinces, 5 autonomous regions, and 4 municipalities in Chinese Mainland, with significant presence in Southern, Western, Eastern, Northern China, and Shandong. Overseas operations include Singapore, Portugal, Australia, New Zealand, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, Botswana, Serbia, and Kazakhstan, reflecting a broad international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the water industry supply chain, focusing on construction, operation, and maintenance of water treatment and distribution facilities. It also provides technical consultancy and sells related machineries, positioning itself as an integrated water system solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes asset-light transformation, cash flow management, and high-quality development. It emphasizes technological innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability, developing core products and cloud-based platforms to improve operational efficiency and environmental performance. R&D focuses on commercializing innovations and expanding asset-light business models domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through service concession arrangements including BOT, TOT, and BOO projects, construction services, technical consultancy, sale of machineries, urban services, and hazardous waste treatment. Income includes fees from water treatment and distribution, construction contracts, equipment sales, and government grants, with some interest income from receivables and loans.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the Group positions itself as a leading water environmental service provider in China with expanding international operations. It leverages technological innovation, asset-light strategies, and comprehensive service offerings to maintain competitive advantages in the water treatment and urban environmental sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The Group reported revenue of approximately RMB24.27 billion in 2024 with a slight year-on-year decrease of 1%. Profit attributable to shareholders was RMB1.68 billion, down 11.5%. It operates over 1,472 water plants with a total daily design capacity exceeding 43 million tons. The Group maintains substantial borrowings and capital expenditures, reflecting a large-scale, capital-intensive business with steady operational scale and strategic transformation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes customer-oriented and innovation-driven operations, offering integrated water system solutions with proprietary technologies like prefabricated water plants and MBBR equipment. Its asset-light transformation enhances flexibility and cash flow, while digital and intelligent management systems improve efficiency and sustainability. The Group’s extensive geographic coverage and diversified service portfolio provide differentiated value in water environmental services.
